The blowout of your dreams

Meet the GlamDry Hair Dryer — an 110,000 RPM brushless motor built for the smoothest, shiniest blowout you can get at home, with minimal heat damage.

Key Features

  • High-speed 110,000 RPM brushless motor for ultra-fast drying
  • 200 million negative ions for smooth, shiny, frizz-free hair
  • 3 temperature settings + 2 wind speed settings for full control
  • 2 styling nozzles included for versatile styling
  • Intelligent thermostat sensor for safe, consistent heat

Product Specifications

  • Motor: 110,000 RPM
  • Power: 1600W
  • Voltage: 110/240V 50-60Hz
  • Material: PC+ABS

FAQ

What makes the GlamDry different from a regular hair dryer? The GlamDry uses a high-speed motor, resulting in faster drying, less heat damage and more shine.

Is it suitable for all hair types? Yes, the multiple temperature and speed settings make it suitable for fine, thick, curly and colour-treated hair.

articles.title: What to Ask Before Booking a Hairstylist for Extensions Application
articles.excerpt: The invitations are on the table, and the hair you see in your mind for the season is a little longer and fuller than the hair in the mirror. Clip-ins and ponytails go in at home, in minutes, with ...
articles.author: Youmi Beauty
articles.content:
The invitations are on the table, and the hair you see in your mind for the season is a little longer and fuller than the hair in the mirror. Clip-ins and ponytails go in at home, in minutes, with no salon appointment at all. Tape-ins and professional installs are a different commitment — and worth a proper conversation before you sit in the chair.

1. Ask which method suits your hair density

Fine hair and very dense hair do not behave the same way under tape. A good stylist will feel your hair between their fingers, check the scalp, and tell you honestly whether tape-in, clip-in or a ponytail will look most natural.

2. Ask how the hair was sourced

Remy, ethically sourced human hair behaves differently from synthetic blends. Ask whether the hair can be heat-styled, how it was processed, and whether the colour can be refreshed.

3. Ask about the removal

The best install is only as good as its removal. Ask what product they use, how long removal takes, and whether a treatment is included afterwards.

4. Ask what aftercare you need at home

Extensions need a different routine: a loop brush, sulphate-free shampoo, and a silk pillowcase go a long way. Ask for a simple three-step routine you can actually keep up with.

5. Ask what happens if the colour is not right

Bring a photo in daylight, not a filtered one. Confirm the colour-matching policy before the hair is cut or installed. At Youmi, we colour-match from a daylight photo before dispatch, free of charge.

Good extensions should look like a better version of your own hair — not like hair sitting on top of it.

articles.title: Colored Lenses With Power vs Without: A Straight Answer for First-Time Buyers
articles.excerpt: Your first pair of colored lenses usually begins with a shade. You picture the golden brown of La Capri at a family dinner, or the deep blue of La Tulum at a wedding, and then the product page asks...
articles.author: Youmi Beauty
articles.content:
Your first pair of coloured lenses usually begins with a shade. You picture the golden brown of La Capri at a family dinner, or the deep blue of La Tulum at a wedding, and then the product page asks a question you were not expecting: with power, or without?

The short answer

If you do not wear a prescription, choose without power. If you already wear glasses or contacts, choose with power and give us your prescription. Do not substitute a powered lens for your normal correction unless the numbers match.

What “power” actually means

Power is the optical correction built into the lens, measured in dioptres. A lens without power is plano — clear vision, no correction. A lens with power has your sphere and, if needed, cylinder values built in.

Can I wear powered lenses just for the colour?

No. Wearing a prescription you do not need can cause headaches, blur and eye strain. If you love a shade and have perfect vision, order it without power.

How to send your prescription

Choose With Power, complete checkout, then reply to your order confirmation with a photo of your prescription. Our team confirms every order by WhatsApp before dispatch.

Comfort checklist for first-time wearers

  • Wash and dry your hands before touching the lens.
  • Check the lens is not inside out — the edge should curve inward like a bowl.
  • Start with two hours on day one and build up slowly.
  • Never sleep or swim in your lenses.
  • Replace monthly, even if they still feel comfortable.
